blocks.text: TURIN–Ben Shelton qualified for the semi-finals of the ATP Finals on Thursday after Arthur Fils lost the first set of his match against world number one Alexander Zverev. Earlier, American Shelton beat Spaniard Rafael Jodar 7-6 (10/8), 7-5, a win that meant Fils had to beat German Zverev in straight sets to snatch second place in the John McEnroe Group. Fils went a set behind in 35 minutes, with Zverev taking the lead 6-4 and was eliminated after losing 6-4, 7-6 (8/6).
